# Swagger UI (vendored)

Static assets from [`swagger-ui-dist`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/swagger-ui-dist)
v5.32.8 (https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui), vendored here so this
documentation page has no external/CDN dependency.

- `swagger-ui.css`
- `swagger-ui-bundle.js`
- `swagger-ui-standalone-preset.js`

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 - see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`
in this directory. Unmodified from upstream.

To upgrade, download the matching files for a newer version from
`https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/swagger-ui-dist@<version>/<file>` and replace
them here, along with `LICENSE`/`NOTICE` from
`https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui` if they changed.
